in_marathi.name: Dhruvan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे He who holds the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhruvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhruva in Hindu mythology was a king who steadfastly pursued the path of dharma. He was cursed and turned into a star, Polaris, which holds the sky stable. This name signifies unwavering determination and steadfastness.
